snippet.title: We Gotta Go: S#!TTY Prototype Trailer | Steam Scream Fest
snippet.description:
Play our S#!TTY prototype—available October 31st on Steam!

We Gotta Go is a spooky, lighthearted co-op game where you and your friends speed through a haunted mansion to find the bathroom before the ghosts scare the S#!T out of you. Inspired by our shared (and embarrassing) experiences!

▴ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967470/We_Gotta_Go/

▴ Join the Discord server:
https://discord.gg/c48u34qC82
